title: Protocol and Debt
author: M. M. Eriksen
blurb: August Nystrom, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
